column1: # sample_meta.TEMPLATE.tsv: copy to  $PROJ/raw/sample_meta.tsv  and fill one row per sample.
# TAB-separated. Lines starting with '#' are ignored by build_manifest.py.
# Columns: sample_id  dataset  accession  chemistry  procurement  region  disease  sex  individual
#   - sample_id : MUST match the per-sample folder name under raw/<dataset>/<sample>/ (build_manifest
#                 keys on this). For GEO, use the GSM / sample name you downloaded the matrix into.
#   - chemistry : 3p (10x 3') or 5p (10x 5'). Liu is 5p; everything else 3p.
#   - procurement: explant | VAD | autopsy | myectomy | donor   (drives the procurement-robustness gate)
#   - region    : LV | RV | IVS | SP | apex   (goes into the DE model as 'anatomy')
#   - disease   : CS | DCM | ICM | ARVC | HCM | NF
#   - sex       : M | F | NA   (NA if unknown; fill where you can: it's a DE covariate)
#   - individual: donor id; default = sample_id if one sample per donor. Set the SAME value across a
#                 donor's multiple samples so the DE model groups them (enables duplicateCorrelation).
# WHICH DATASETS NEED ROWS HERE:
#   These go through CellBender (per-sample raw matrices) and have NO embedded metadata, so they REQUIRE
#   rows: Neyazi, Larson, Chin2022, Chin2021, and Liu (5' standalone).
#   Reichart is a single CELLxGENE h5ad whose obs already carries disease/region/sex: it does NOT need
#   rows here (it isn't in the CellBender array).
# The rows below are EXAMPLES with the constant columns pre-filled per the plan. Replace the placeholder
# sample_ids with your real ones and expand to the full sample counts (e.g. Neyazi has 41 CS samples).
sample_id
# ---- Neyazi CS (GSE319770, 3' v3, explant/VAD/autopsy, LV/RV/SP). 41 samples: expand this block. ----
NEYAZI_CS01
NEYAZI_CS02
NEYAZI_CS03
NEYAZI_CS04
# ... continue through all 41 Neyazi samples ...
# ---- Larson HCM (GSE174691, 3' v3, septal myectomy, IVS only). ~9 samples. ----
LARSON_HCM01
LARSON_HCM02
# ... continue ...
# ---- Chin2022 (GSE181764, 3' v3): HCM = myectomy/IVS ; NF = donor/IVS. ----
CHIN2022_HCM01
CHIN2022_NF01
# ... continue ...
# ---- Chin2021 NF (GSE161921, 3' v3, donor, IVS). ~4 samples. ----
CHIN2021_NF01
CHIN2021_NF02
# ... continue ...
# ---- Liu (GSE205734, 5' v1.1, explant, LV): CS x4 + ICM x3. Standalone 5' arm. ----
LIU_CS01
LIU_CS02
LIU_ICM01
LIU_ICM02
